newsitem.title: UK: Stradivarius violin fails to sell at auction.
newsitem.headline: Stradivarius violin fails to sell at auction.

text.p: A rare Stradivarius violin failed to reach its reserve price when put up for auction in London on Tuesday.
"Bidding stopped at 580,000 pounds ($971,500), It failed to reach its reserve price," said a spokeswoman for the auctioneers Phillips.
The violin, made by the famed Italian craftsman Antonio Stradivari, was being offered on the open market for the first time in its 302-year history.
It had a rich and varied career, passing from the Marquis of Pommerau through musical instrument collections to violinist Alfredo Campoli.
